title: How Much Fiber in Strawberries? 2.9g per Cup
description: Strawberries: about 2.9 g of fiber per 1 cup, whole (10% DV), from USDA FoodData Central. Portion table, comparisons, free calculator.
h1: How much fiber is in strawberries?
intro: Strawberries rank #12 of 15 fruits on this site for fiber per serving. Every figure below is scaled from USDA FoodData Central, the same data the calculator uses.

dataTable.caption: Fiber in strawberries by portion
dataTable.note: Fiber and calories are scaled from USDA FoodData Central per-100 g values (rows listed under Sources). % Daily Value uses the 28 g reference on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels. Brands, ripeness, and cooking change real values.

sections.heading: How much fiber is in strawberries?
paragraphs: USDA FoodData Central lists strawberries, raw at 2 g of fiber per 100 g. One serving (1 cup, whole; 144 g) therefore has about 2.9 g of fiber and 46 calories. That is 10% of the 28 g Daily Value on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels, or 12% of a 25 g day and 8% of a 38 g day.

Strawberries are the most widely eaten berry in the U.S. but one of the lower-fiber ones per cup. That does not make them a bad choice; it just means they work best as part of a meal with another fiber source.

sections.heading: Whole vs sliced cups
paragraphs: Sliced strawberries pack more tightly into a measuring cup than whole berries, so a sliced cup weighs more and carries a bit more fiber. The table shows both.
Strawberry yogurt, jam, or a strawberry smoothie from a shop usually contains far less fruit than a cup of fresh berries. Check the label or ask what is in it.

sections.heading: How strawberries compare with other fruits
paragraphs: Of the 15 fruits on this site, strawberries rank #12 for fiber per typical serving and #4 for fiber per calorie. That works out to 6.3 g of fiber per 100 calories, a high ratio: you get a lot of fiber for the calories.

Close neighbors by serving: [guava](/fiber-in-guava) at 3 g (1 fruit); [banana](/fiber-in-banana) at 3.1 g (1 medium (7–8")); [mango](/fiber-in-mango) at 2.6 g (1 cup pieces). Across all 50 foods in the [fiber-in-foods table](/fiber-in-foods), strawberries are #19 for fiber per calorie.

sections.heading: Adding strawberries to your day
paragraphs: Pair strawberries with something denser in fiber: a slice of whole-grain toast, oatmeal, or a spoon of chia. A strawberry-banana smoothie with oats is an easy combination.

Example: 1 cup strawberries, 1 cup oatmeal, 1 tbsp chia seeds. Using the same USDA values as the calculator, that comes to about 11 g of fiber, with 2.9 g from the strawberries. Adjust the amounts in the calculator to match your plate.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in 100 g of strawberries?
faqs.a: 2 g, according to USDA FoodData Central (Strawberries, raw). That is the figure every portion on this page is scaled from.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in strawberries (1 cup, sliced)?
faqs.a: About 3.3 g, for 166 g. Weigh your portion or edit grams in the calculator for a closer estimate.

faqs.q: Are strawberries a good source of fiber?
faqs.a: A cup gives roughly 10% of the Daily Value, which counts as a good source in label terms but is modest next to raspberries or blackberries.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in one strawberry?
faqs.a: A medium berry (about 12 g) has around a quarter of a gram. It takes a full cup to reach about 3 g.
